questions.question: Who played Jack Dawson in Titanic?
questions.note: Kate Winslet played Rose; they were later reunited in Revolutionary Road.

questions.question: Who played Forrest Gump’s childhood friend and love interest, Jenny?
questions.note: Credited in 1994 as Robin Wright; later Robin Wright Penn for a stretch.

questions.question: Who played Clarice Starling in The Silence of the Lambs?
questions.note: Opposite Anthony Hopkins. Moore played Clarice in the 2001 sequel.

questions.question: Who played Agent Smith in The Matrix?
questions.note: Reeves is Neo; Fishburne is Morpheus; Pantoliano is Cypher. Weaving also played Elrond.

questions.question: Who played Will Turner in the Pirates of the Caribbean films?
questions.note: Depp is Jack Sparrow; Knightley is Elizabeth Swann.

questions.question: Who played Professor McGonagall in the Harry Potter films?
questions.note: Thompson is Trelawney; Walters is Mrs. Weasley; Staunton is Umbridge.

questions.question: Who played the Joker in The Dark Knight?
questions.note: A posthumous Best Supporting Actor Oscar.

questions.question: Who played Loki in the Thor and Avengers films?
questions.note: Hemsworth is Thor; Holland is Spider-Man; Cumberbatch is Doctor Strange.

questions.question: Who played Katniss Everdeen in The Hunger Games films?
questions.note: Woodley was Tris in Divergent; Stewart was Bella in Twilight.

questions.question: Who played James Bond in Casino Royale (2006), his first film in the role?
questions.note: Brosnan’s last Bond film was Die Another Day (2002).
